d: The cloister of the convent of St. Just. On the right there is a lit chapel. You can see through a golden gate the tomb of Charles V. On the left, it leads to the outside. At the end the inner door of the cloister. Garden with tall cypresses. It is the dawn. Chorus of Friars, A Friar, then Don Carlo.
Don Carlo, the Friar still praying
Don Carlo, Rodrigo.

A laughing site at the doors of the cloister of St. Right. A fountain; seats of sods; groups of orange trees, pine trees and lentisks. On the horizon the blue mountains of Extremadura. At the bottom right, the door of the convent. Ascending there for a few steps. The princess of Eboli, Tebaldo, the Countess of Aremberg, Dame della regina, Paggi.
Said and Elizabeth leaving the convent.
Detti and Rodrigo.
Said, and Don Carlo.
Elizabeth, Philip, Tebaldo, the Countess of Aremberg, Rodrigo, Eboli, Chorus, Paggi, entering later.
Philip and Rodrigo, then the Count of Lerma and some Lords.
The Queen's gardens in Madrid. A closed grove. At the bottom, under a verzure arch, a statue with a fountain. Light night. Don Carlo alone.
Don Carlo, Eboli, veiled.
Say, Rodrigo.
Don Carlo and Rodrigo.

A large square before Our Donna d'Atocha. To the right the church, to which leads a large staircase. To the left a palace. At the end, another staircase that descends to a lower square in the middle of which rises a stake of which you can see the top. Large buildings and distant hills form the horizon. The bells ring at festival. The cast, contained just by the Alabardieri, invades the scene. Chorus of Popolo, then choir of Friars, who lead the Condemned.
Say, Rodrigo, the Count of Lerma, Elizabeth, Tebaldo, Paggi, Dame, Lords of the Court, Royal Heralds.

Said, Philip and Friars. The doors of the church in opening let Philip see with the crown on his head, falling under a canopy in the middle of the friars. The Lords bow, the People bow. The Great cover their heads.
Say, Don Carlo, Flemish Congressmen.
The King's Cabinet in Madrid.
Philip, Count of Lerma, Inquisitor.
Philip, Elizabeth.
Say, Rodrigo and the princess of Eboli.
Elizabeth and Eboli.
Eboli lonely.

The prison of Don Carlo. A dark underground, in which were thrown quickly some furnishings of the court. At the bottom iron gate that separates the prison from a court that dominates it and in which the guards come and go. A staircase leads you from the upper floors of the building. Don Carlo and Rodrigo.
Filippo con seguito, Grandi di Spagna, Don Carlo, the Count of Lerma, Eboli, the great Inquisitor.
The cloister of the convent of Saint Just as in the first act. Night. Moonlight. Elizabeth alone.
Don Carlo, Elizabeth.
Said, Philip, the great Inquisitor, A Friar, Family of the Holy Office.
